goal.en: In a fresh slow conversation, the learner can identify basic facts about a person or family.
goal.ar: أن تفهم وصفًا صوتيًا بسيطًا لأشخاص أو عائلة وتنسب كل حقيقة للشخص الصحيح.

scope.performance: three-person slow conversation or message without transcript

video.english_pronunciation: General American with inline SSML IPA

variants.teach_back: Explain how a new relationship or name starts a new person card.

privacy: The learner may use fictional safe information.
No microphone permission or raw-answer retention is required.
accessibility: Every spoken model has visible text.
Colour is never the only feedback signal.
Arabic and English reading directions are explicit.

bounded_scope_notes: Introduce basic people words and evidence-supported appearance or manner descriptions for identification.
Recycle only task-provided or voluntary family and personal-life vocabulary.
Use /f/-/v/ and selected front/central vowels only where a key person, family word, or number could change.
